items.text: Great to tour the Grey Team facility today, a wonderful veteran-owned nonprofit right here in Boca Raton dedicated to eliminating veteran suicide through health and wellness regimens. https://t.co/9CV9AIzfEj

Today was the last meeting for my 2023-24 Congressional Youth Cabinet, and it has been incredible learning with this group. For this final meeting, we had a mock hurricane exercise with @PBCDEM, and this storm had a particularly frightening name. https://t.co/J8SJhwvjKT

Gun violence doesn’t just kill, it haunts our communities. People shouldn’t be living in constant fear that their town will suffer the same tragedy as Parkland did. I applaud the Surgeon General’s historic advisory recognizing this as a public health crisis.

We all want healthier food, but RFK Jr.  leading HHS would be disastrous for medical research and vaccination rates. There is a reason Trump’s own transition co-chair said this pick would never happen. Even he knows this shouldn’t happen.

The ICC turned a blind eye to many atrocities, including Bashar al-Assad’s use of chemical weapons to kill hundreds of thousands of Syrians. But when it comes to Israel defending itself against Hamas, the ICC doesn’t hesitate to exercise this antisemitic double standard.
Happy New Year! I hope that 2025 brings health and happiness to all our families, our communities, and our country. https://t.co/iIlFbzSxW0

52 years ago, Roe v Wade affirmed women’s right to make their own healthcare decisions- until the Court took that freedom away.

Personal healthcare decisions should be just that- personal - not dictated by politicians, judges, or bureaucrats. We must return to the Roe standard. https://t.co/zc8d5gdwC0

Hundreds of thousands of FL seniors rely on hearing aids to go about life, and meeting that medical necessity shouldn't be a financial burden. I'm backing the Medicare Hearing Aid Coverage Act so Medicare expands to finally cover hearing aids and exams. https://t.co/MWXsWZCzot

This #WorldCancerDay, I’m thinking of my dad who passed away from pancreatic cancer and all the patients and families facing this terrible disease. I’m committed to doing whatever I can and working with anyone I can to support the tools and research we need to finally beat it.

Thank you to these Floridians with @NACHC for presenting me with their 2025 Distinguished Community Health Center Advocate Award! I appreciate all our CHCs do to keep FL families healthy, and I’m going to keep working to deliver what they need to maintain and grow that mission. https://t.co/niEEsvgi8F

Through their “Kidney Buddy” app, Alan, Jason, Alina, and Madeline designed a way for Chronic Kidney Disease patients to better manage their health. It has the potential to help millions, and it rightfully earned them the win in our Congressional App Challenge. Congratulations! https://t.co/uw3S8z9crP

It’s an honor to receive the Congressional Advocacy Award from @MyotonicStrong. Their work in helping patients and families navigate myotonic dystrophy is critical, and I will always support federal efforts to accelerate research on treatments and cures. https://t.co/dnvHJBzjWv

Florida State Representative Daryl Campbell proudly serves Florida House District 99, which includes Fort Lauderdale, Wilton Manors, Plantation, Lauderhill, and Lauderdale Lakes. In the legislature, he has been a tireless champion for improving access to healthcare, education, and housing in Broward County.

Dr. Patricia-Rowe King, MD is playing a huge role keeping our communities healthy as a pediatrician at Broward Health Medical Center. A University of Miami Medical School graduate, she has over 35 years of experience in the medical field. https://t.co/kwETiWCg7b

Today, I filed an amendment to the House Republicans’ continuing resolution that clarifies it DOES NOT give the President authority to reduce funding for Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid.

Surely nobody will take issue with this.
So we’re going to “Make America Healthy Again” by throwing people off their affordable healthcare coverage? So much for lowering costs.

If the Mike Johnson CR wasn’t a prelude to cut Social Security and Medicare, why didn’t the speaker accept my simple amendment to protect it? And let’s not forget Republicans removed their own speaker over doing a CR.

We need a bipartisan solution to keep government open. https://t.co/Wlf4eiE23m

Floridians rely on the postal service to receive everything from lifesaving medication to their Social Security checks, and it happens thanks to dedicated postal workers like Dot. Great to talk with her about the importance of protecting this critical resource. https://t.co/v4wdKIE8FO

Melida Akiti is a Corporate Transformation Executive overseeing strategic planning and partnerships for @BrowardHealth, ACO/Population Health, Weston Urgent Care, and @CDTC. With a proven record in healthcare leadership, she’s also held roles at @mhshospital and @JacksonHealth. https://t.co/TnLlN55Fdl

Any family that’s had to face a cancer diagnosis knows just how important it is to have dedicated physicians by their side. A big thank you to these Florida oncologists for the care they provide to so many in our community. https://t.co/tMpDT2gH86

The National Flood Insurance Program expires in September. Congress needs to be proactive and extend this program so homeowners and businesses have certainty that the flood insurance policies they’ve paid into will be there when disaster strikes. https://t.co/ohJwloEMaq

I’m leading a bill to extend the National Flood Insurance Program before it expires in September. With hurricane season around the corner, homeowners and businesses need certainty that the policies they’ve paid into will be there when disaster strikes. https://t.co/bVvVLuOwC9

Good to meet with some Florida pharmacists with @Commpharmacy for a productive discussion on standing up to pharmaceutical middlemen and protecting Florida seniors’ access to quality, affordable healthcare through Medicare. https://t.co/JUTf3meMY8

This reckless plan rips lifesaving healthcare away from millions of people who depend on Medicaid in red and blue areas alike, including more than 90,000 people in my district alone. Doesn’t sound like making America healthy to me.

I’ve signed onto a petition in the House to force a vote that would protect Medicaid and food assistance programs, which are lifelines for millions of Floridians.

If House Republicans claim their budget doesn’t slash these programs, they should have no problem taking this vote.
